summary: NVIDIA announced record financial results for Q4 and fiscal year 2026, with Q4 revenue of $68.1 billion (up 20% Q/Q, 73% Y/Y) and full-year revenue of $215.9 billion (up 65% Y/Y). GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins were 75.0% and 75.2% for Q4, and 71.1% and 71.3% for the fiscal year. GAAP and non-GAAP diluted EPS were $1.76 and $1.62 for Q4, and $4.90 and $4.77 for fiscal 2026. The company returned $41.1 billion to shareholders during fiscal 2026 and had $58.5 billion remaining under share repurchase authorization. A quarterly cash dividend of $0.01 per share will be paid on April 1, 2026, to shareholders of record on March 11, 2026.
